title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

ranker_run_url.title: Ranker run URL
ranker_run_url.description: Where is the run that computed this week's signals and scores?

session_slot.title: Session slot
session_slot.description: When is the architecture review session this report serves (e.g. Monday 10:00)?

time_box_minutes.title: Time box (minutes)
time_box_minutes.description: How many minutes does the session have (45 by default)?

window_from.title: Window from
window_from.description: From which timestamp (ISO 8601) were PRs opened or merged scanned?

window_to.title: Window to
window_to.description: To which timestamp (ISO 8601) were PRs opened or merged scanned?
